note: Registry data could not be retrieved. The web_search tool (DuckDuckGo/searx) was unavailable (connection refused) for the whole session, and Bing returned only irrelevant results for every quoted query, so no MCA/CIN, PAN, GSTIN, incorporation date or financial filing could be located. Direct fetches of registry aggregators were blocked: zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, tofler.in and instafinancials.com returned 404 for the guessed slugs, Google returned HTTP 429. Therefore CIN/LLPIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, registered state, MCA status and revenue FY25/FY26 are all null - not public/not retrieved, nothing invented. No rejection applied: there is no evidence the entity does not exist, is struck off, liquidated or bankrupt - the absence of data is a research limitation, not a negative finding. Role recorded as unknown (name suggests equipment supply, but no registry evidence of manufacturing vs trading). Note also that the declared HS code 854221 is a 6-digit code for electronic integrated circuits/micro-assemblies, which is inconsistent with an 'access platform equipment' business; per project rules this is not a rejection ground - the code should be corrected to the actual product code once the company's real activity is confirmed. Recommended next step: re-run with working search, or verify directly on mca.gov.in MCA21 master data and the GST portal search by legal name.
